aft_corner_fit.method: Local outer lower-lip profile fitted to actual upper-leaf leading skin and inherited aperture; short fixed jamb tips finish the triangular corner. Central deck, node hierarchy/TRS and all clips remain untouched.

before.method: 201 aperture-boundary stations per side over Z6.2454..6.40; exact nearest point to triangles of lower ramp, upper leaf and fixed jambs. Aft lip sampled independently in transverse sections. Asset fit, not real aircraft tolerances.
